description: Annual Vehicle Distance Traveled in Miles and Related Data, 2000-2024 (VM-1) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. Annual Vehicle Distance Traveled (VMT) in miles by Highway Category and Vehicle Type. Also provides person miles of travel, number of registered vehicles, VMT per registered vehicle, fuel use, gallons of fuel use per vehicle, and gallons of fuel per vehicle miles. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 5 columns, among them Year, Vehicle_Type, Item, Report_Year, Data. The portal shows 2026-06-08 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
